tool_args.rationale: The three-coefficient law fitted on the first six rows predicts all three subsequent batch observations within 3e-8 at H = 0.6. Submit it for fresh confirmation; the paid data support the base law but do not establish what happens above the observed gradient range.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All paid gradients are at or below 2.20, so the proposed threshold and strength cannot be fitted. Submit the supported base law for confirmation rather than assume a switch.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition or Cobb–Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Haldane omits the measured gradient dependence, while Cobb–Douglas replaces the corroborated saturation and additive square-root term with a single product.
Both informative menu probes have already been acquired, and the remaining nuisance probe cannot resolve the high-gradient branch.
